verdict.rationale: INPI documents a representative (mandatário) rail: holders and applicants of industrial property rights can update their representatives' data for free, which shows a sanctioned representative role that acts on their behalf. The evidence is a single thin mention and does not explain who qualifies, how a representative is appointed, or what they are authorized to do. Licensing (docs-25) covers exploitation rights, not acting for the company, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: documentation of who may act as an authorized representative (e.g., an official agent register), the appointment and power-of-attorney process, scope of delegated authority, revocation, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the service documents a sanctioned third-party rail — designees, authorized providers, registered agents, or representatives — through which a provider can act for my company

citations.quote: Os titulares ou requerentes de direitos de propriedade industrial podem atualizar gratuitamente os dados dos seus mandatários
